design_philosophy: Maximum readability and ease-of-use for older adults on mobile. Restrained, professional, high contrast, large tap targets. Utility-first.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8. gap-6, gap-8.

dashboard.alerts: Full width at top. Highlighted with thick left border (border-l-8 border-red-700).
dashboard.navigation_cards: 1 column on mobile, 2 columns on tablet, 3 on desktop. gap-6.
dashboard.help_card: Distinctive layout, spanning full width at bottom, highlighted background (bg-slate-100).

buttons.primary: w-full sm:w-auto min-h-[56px] text-lg font-bold rounded-lg bg-blue-900 text-white hover:bg-blue-800 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-300 focus:outline-none flex items-center justify-center transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: w-full sm:w-auto min-h-[56px] text-lg font-bold rounded-lg bg-white text-blue-900 border-2 border-blue-900 hover:bg-slate-50 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-300 focus:outline-none flex items-center justify-center transition-colors

cards.navigation: bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-blue-900 hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-4
cards.informational: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm

inputs.text: min-h-[56px] text-lg p-4 border-2 border-slate-300 rounded-lg focus:border-blue-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 w-full bg-white text-slate-900

visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react. Size: w-10 h-10 or w-12 h-12. Stroke width: 2. Color: text-blue-900.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on borders (border-2) to separate content. High-contrast boundaries are easier for elderly eyes to distinguish than soft shadows.

accessibility.tap_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all clickable elements. 56px height preferred.
accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA (4.5:1 min). Text must be dark on light backgrounds.
accessibility.motion: No decorative animations. Only functional state changes (color transitions).
accessibility.focus: Explicit visible focus rings on all interactive elements.

testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive and key informational elements using kebab-case, role-based naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use purely .js and .jsx syntax, no TypeScript types.
Do NOT use glassmorphism, transparent header backgrounds, or complex gradients.
Keep the visual language utilitarian but highly professional.
The 'Important Now' section must be immediately noticeable, left-aligned, with strong borders.
Ensure Shadcn components are modified to have larger hit areas, thicker borders, and larger fonts.
Every single interactive element MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute.
Left-align text inside content pages for easier reading; center-align only the main 5 Dashboard cards.
Limit colors to the defined palette. The Deep Navy Blue is the only accent color.
